summary.en: A value resolves in its own digit slots: symbols flicker 24 times a second, never other digits, then lock left to right; or it counts up in its own format.
summary.zh: 一个数值在自己的数位里定格：符号每秒闪 24 次、从不显示别的数字，再从左到右锁定；或者按原格式往上数。

fits: A measured value arriving: a benchmark result, a count, a ratio.
notFor: Words; a value that is not measured; slot-machine fun (the symbols are not digits on purpose).

intent.en: The number feels measured rather than typed: it searches, then settles, and no frame shows a wrong value.
intent.zh: 让数字像是量出来的而不是写上去的：先搜索再落定，任何一帧都不显示错的数。

content.en: One value (≤ 9 chars, digits with optional unit or sign) and an optional label (≤ 26 chars).
content.zh: 一个数值（≤ 6 字，数字加可选单位或符号）和可选标签（≤ 10 字）。

fits.zh: 测量值到来的时刻：跑分结果、计数、倍数。

notFor.zh: 文字；不是测量来的数；老虎机式的花哨（故意用符号而不是数字）。

pairs.note: the answer's digits while the highlight decides

en: Only digits scramble; units, signs and words stand from the first frame.
zh: 只有数字乱码；单位、符号和文字从第一帧就在。

overlaps.note: an odometer: columns roll through digits; here symbols that are never digits, in fixed slots
runtime hand-off: a mono line of letters; here digit slots of a proportional face

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
